items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: I don't know whether it's John, I think it's Johnny. No. His name is Benson, too.

ctx.x: Yeah. I wish I could call his real name so I could... His name is Benson, though.
Yeah. I don't know whether it's John, I think it's Johnny. No. His name is Benson, too. His name is this?
Yeah, just like that Johnny Benson. Yeah. Yeah. Louis Armstrong, Louis Armstrong.
